name: health-checkup
description: Periodic repository health checkup. Counts — never blocks — the obligations offloaded during development: unresolved TODOs, "guaranteed elsewhere" claims classified as verified / missing / untraceable, stale and unmilestoned issues, coverage, and spec-implementation drift. An LLM only extracts where a claim points; scripts decide whether that place exists, do the arithmetic, and append the numbers next to their baselines. The diagnosis is left to humans.
